mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( user_id, password, name, phone, email, birth, job, gender, role ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{birth}, #{job}, #{gender}, #{role} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, password, name, phone, email, birth, job, gender, subscribe, created_at, deleted, ai_count, role, deleted, withdrawn_at, login_restriction_days, login_restricted_at, login_restricted_until, login_restriction_reason, login_restricted_by FROM member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
SELECT user_id AS userId, name, phone, email, birth, job, gender, subscribe, ai_count AS aiCount, role, created_at AS createdAt FROM member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{request.name}, phone = #{request.phone}, job = #{request.job}, gender = #{request.gender} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
UPDATE member SET ai_count = ai_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_lawyers ( user_id, firm_name, sido, sigungu, region_detail, experience_years, specialty ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{firmName}, #{sido}, #{sigungu}, #{regionDetail}, #{experienceYears}, #{specialty} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, name, phone, email, birth, job, gender, subscribe, created_at, deleted, ai_count, role FROM member
SELECT DISTINCT job FROM member WHERE deleted = 1 AND job IS NOT NULL AND job != '' ORDER BY job
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET login_restriction_days = 0, login_restricted_at = NULL, login_restricted_until = NULL, login_restriction_reason = NULL, login_restricted_by = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
